source: Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) — Finance Act 2023, Tax Laws (Amendment) Act 2024 & NSSF Year 4 Schedule (Feb 2026)

sha.note: Social Health Insurance Fund (SHIF) contribution is 2.75% of gross salary (minimum KES 300/month) remitted to the Social Health Authority (SHA). Under the Tax Laws (Amendment) Act, 2024, SHIF is a full pre-tax allowable deduction.

nssf.note: Under the NSSF Act, 2013 Third Schedule (Year 4, effective February 2026), Tier I Lower Earnings Limit is KES 9,000 (max KES 540) and Tier II Upper Earnings Limit is KES 108,000 (max KES 5,940; total max KES 6,480/month matched by employer).

housingLevy.note: Affordable Housing Levy is 1.5% of gross salary for both employee and employer. Under the Tax Laws (Amendment) Act, 2024 (effective 27 Dec 2024), the employee's contribution is a full pre-tax deductible expense when computing taxable pay.

notes: PAYE is calculated on taxable income after deducting NSSF, SHIF (SHA), and Affordable Housing Levy (per the Tax Laws Amendment Act, 2024).
Every resident individual taxpayer receives a mandatory Personal Relief of KES 2,400 per month (KES 28,800 per year).
NSSF Year 4 rates (effective February 2026): 6% of pensionable pay with Tier I capped at KES 9,000 (KES 540) and Tier II up to KES 108,000 (max total KES 6,480/month, matched by employer).
Social Health Insurance Fund (SHIF) under SHA is 2.75% of gross monthly salary (minimum KES 300/month), fully tax-deductible.
Affordable Housing Levy (AHL) is 1.5% of gross monthly salary from the employee and 1.5% from the employer, with the employee portion fully tax-deductible.
